name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Original admission letter from the institution on official letterhead, specifying the program's nature, terms, and duration.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission at a recognized Indian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Bank guarantee letter demonstrating capacity to cover a minimum of EUR 500/month for tuition, housing, and living expenses (self-funded or sponsor-supported).
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a bank guarantee letter meeting the minimum monthly amount.

requirements.blocker_text: Must register with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) within 14 days of first arrival if the continuous stay will exceed 180 days.

outcome.duration_length: tied to course duration, typically issued and extended annually via FRRO

sources.title: Embassy of India, Paris (official mission page) -- Student Visa document requirements: original admission letter on institutional letterhead specifying program nature/terms/duration; bank guarantee letter for minimum EUR 500/month; applications must be submitted more than 30 days before course start; passport valid 6+ months with 3+ blank pages; additional requirements for internship (company sponsorship, minimum salary Rs. 3.60 lakh/year), exchange programs, and medical studies (Ministry of Health NOC)

Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India -- Foreigners Registration: multiple-entry visa holders (including students) staying continuously beyond 180 days must register with the FRRO within 14 days of first arrival; children under 16 exempted

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (India). Published on tier-1 sourcing (an Indian diplomatic mission page plus the Ministry of External Affairs). The specific financial/admission figures (EUR 500/month, Rs. 3.60 lakh internship salary) come from the Paris mission's own published checklist -- exact figures may vary slightly by issuing mission, which is disclosed rather than smoothed over. FRRO registration is a general obligation shared with other long-stay visa categories (see in_work_permit.json), not unique to students.
